files.name: links.parquet

columns.meaning: Stable public body or original-link key

files.row_meaning: One stable link key mapped to one release-local document row

notes.link_key: First 8 body SHA-256 bytes, or first 8 SHA-256 bytes of url: plus exact original URL for recovery links. Binary key; hex is a display encoding.

files.name: urls.parquet
files.row_meaning: One lookup key and document row pair; an address can identify several editions

notes.lookup_key: First 8 SHA-256 bytes of lookup: plus fixed lookup_url(u): remove scheme, leading www, default port, fragment and one trailing path slash; lowercase host; preserve query bytes. This is not capture-profile url_key.

columns.meaning: Whether this source names the saved file

columns.name: first_seen
columns.meaning: First observed date of this source

files.row_meaning: One source address/context occurrence within a document

notes.member_path: Path inside a captured archive container. Interpret together with the source URL; not a document key.

columns.name: recovered_url
columns.meaning: Address where the recovered copy was found

files.row_meaning: One recovered file occurrence within a document

files.name: meetings.parquet

columns.name: title
columns.meaning: Document or publisher title when known

files.row_meaning: One event, shared House/Senate event ID namespace

notes.committees[]: Host/participant roles belong to this meeting-committee association.
notes.transcripts[]: Package identifier and release-local document row identify the same retained hearing transcript.
notes.videos[]: Publisher recording links; video_key joins retained recordings when available.

columns.name: display_order
columns.meaning: 1-based witness display order within the occasion or panel

columns.name: bioguide_id
columns.meaning: Bioguide identifier when the witness is a Member of Congress

files.row_meaning: One named witness appearance at a meeting, package, or page; not a deduplicated person

notes.occasion: meeting:{event_id}, package:{package_id}, or page:{sha256_prefix}. Witness keys hash the occasion and normalized name; names alone never join appearances.

columns.name: event_ids
columns.meaning: Sorted meeting event IDs associated with this recording

columns.name: tracks
columns.type: list<struct<body fixed[32],suffix dict,format dict,language dict,production dict>>
columns.meaning: Captured caption, subtitle, and playlist tracks from their latest good fetch

notes.tracks[]: Embedded captured caption/subtitle/playlist files. Language and production describe each track; these are not document-list rows.

notes.names[]: Embedded names with half-open [start,end) dates, ordered latest start first. Null endpoints mean unknown or open-ended.

columns.name: terms
columns.type: list<struct<chamber dict,state dict,district int16,party dict,start date32,end date32>>
columns.meaning: Congressional service terms ordered latest first

columns.name: cross_ids
columns.type: struct<lis string,opensecrets string,govtrack string,icpsr string,wikidata string,fec list<string>>

notes.terms[]: Embedded service terms with half-open [start,end) dates, latest first. Terms do not establish historical committee seats.
notes.cross_ids: External dataset identifiers; an identifier does not imply that dataset is included in this release.

notes.cbo_estimates[]: Embedded publication IDs, dates and descriptions, not full CBO estimate text.
notes.floor_votes[]: One embedded vote per vote_id per bill; basis distinguishes vote_record from bill_action. Counts are vote totals, not member positions.
notes.amendments[]: Embedded direct/chained amendment summaries; 119th Congress coverage until upstream backfill.
notes.committee_activities[]: Embedded committee events; several activities can refer to the same committee.

recipes.title: Documents related to a bill
recipes.sql:
SELECT l.list_row,l.filename,l.title,hex(d.link_key) AS link_key
FROM "list" l JOIN detail d USING (list_row)
WHERE list_contains(l.measure_keys,?) ORDER BY l.list_row LIMIT 100
notes: Does not require the bounded bills table to contain this identifier.

recipes.title: Documents and hearing titles
recipes.sql:
SELECT l.list_row,l.filename,m.event_id,m.title
FROM "list" l JOIN meetings m ON list_contains(l.meeting_keys,CAST(m.event_id AS VARCHAR))
WHERE m.event_id=? ORDER BY l.list_row LIMIT 100
recipes.result_row: One document associated with the selected hearing
notes: meeting_keys stores decimal text; event_id is an integer.

recipes.title: Documents submitted by a witness appearance
recipes.sql:
SELECT w.witness_key,w.name,l.list_row,l.filename
FROM witnesses w JOIN "list" l ON list_contains(l.witness_keys,w.witness_key)
WHERE w.witness_key=? ORDER BY l.list_row LIMIT 100
recipes.result_row: One submitted document for this appearance
notes: Use a witness_key, never a person-name join.

recipes.title: Printed hearings containing a witness appearance
recipes.sql:
SELECT w.witness_key,w.name,d.package_id,l.list_row,l.filename
FROM witnesses w JOIN detail d ON d.package_id=w.package_id JOIN "list" l USING (list_row)
WHERE w.witness_key=? ORDER BY l.list_row LIMIT 100
recipes.result_row: One retained transcript document for the appearance
notes: No package_id means no published package association; submitted documents use a different relationship.

recipes.title: Committee members for a published Congress
recipes.sql:
SELECT r.congress,r.system_code,c.name AS committee,r.bioguide_id,m.name,r.title,r.rank,r.party
FROM rosters r LEFT JOIN committees c USING (system_code) LEFT JOIN members m USING (bioguide_id)
WHERE r.system_code=? AND r.congress=? ORDER BY r.rank,r.bioguide_id LIMIT 100
notes: An empty historical result does not establish that the committee had no members.

recipes.title: Printed hearings related to a nomination
recipes.sql:
SELECT n.nomination_id,d.package_id,l.list_row,l.filename
FROM nominations n JOIN detail d ON list_contains(n.transcripts,d.package_id) JOIN "list" l USING (list_row)
WHERE n.nomination_id=? ORDER BY l.list_row LIMIT 100
notes: Preserve the nomination part, for example 119-pn-730-2.

recipes.title: Vote summaries associated with a bill
recipes.sql:
SELECT b.bill_id,v.vote_id,v.basis,v.chamber,v.date,v.question,v.result,v.yea,v.nay
FROM bills b,UNNEST(b.floor_votes) AS votes(v)
WHERE b.bill_id=? ORDER BY v.date,v.vote_id LIMIT 100
recipes.result_row: One embedded roll-call summary for this bill
notes: This is vote-level data, not member voting records. Unnest only the list you need; unnesting amendments as well would multiply votes.

recipes.title: Vote summaries associated with a nomination
recipes.sql:
SELECT n.nomination_id,v.vote_id,v.date,v.question,v.result,v.yea,v.nay
FROM nominations n,UNNEST(n.floor_votes) AS votes(v)
WHERE n.nomination_id=? ORDER BY v.date,v.vote_id LIMIT 100

recipes.title: Captured tracks for a hearing
recipes.sql:
SELECT r.video_key,hex(t.body) AS body,t.suffix,t.format,t.language,t.production
FROM recordings r,UNNEST(r.tracks) AS tracks(t)
WHERE list_contains(r.event_ids,CAST(? AS BIGINT)) ORDER BY r.video_key,t.language,t.format LIMIT 100
notes: Construct the body URL using the recorded suffix; a track is not a list document.

recipes.title: Other editions sharing an endpoint
recipes.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT other.list_row,other.filename,other.document_date
FROM "list" selected JOIN "list" other ON list_has_any(selected.version_keys,other.version_keys)
WHERE selected.list_row=? AND other.list_row<>selected.list_row ORDER BY other.list_row LIMIT 100
notes: list_row belongs only to the selected release. Multiple shared endpoint keys must not duplicate a document.
